composition_label: Normal research -> Ticket triage & routing -> Adaptive onboarding -> Structured extraction

construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored for this isolated build using clearly labeled synthetic fixtures

shared_schema.input: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, query, documents[id,text], tickets[id,title,description,document_ids], profile[experience,preference], policy, onboarding_steps, extraction_schema
shared_schema.policy: Ordered categories[id,keywords,queue,owner], default_category, ordered priorities[priority,keywords], default_priority, research_limit (1..100)
shared_schema.extraction_schema: Ordered fields[name,pattern,required]; regex must contain a named 'value' capture group
shared_schema.output: One envelope with schema_version, status, synthetic, immutable copy of input, stages containing the contiguous prefix research/triage/adaptive/extract
shared_schema.source: document_id,start,end,text; zero-based half-open Unicode character offsets into original document
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate boundary checks input, stage ordering, identities, exact citations, accountability, evidence/document handoffs, prerequisite ordering and missing-field consistency before and after every stage
shared_schema.errors: Validation, file and JSON decoding errors print one JSON object with status=error and exit 2

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated extractive findings and exact sources; each ticket only receives findings from its linked documents
Validated category drives path selection; priority, queue, accountable owner, finding IDs and document IDs propagate
Validated prerequisite-ordered step selections expand ticket document scope; extraction consumes only these documents and retains routing, evidence and step lineage

behavior.research: Unicode word-overlap retrieval over punctuation/newline-delimited passages, descending score, stable document/span ties, configurable result limit; findings are verbatim
behavior.triage: Case-insensitive boundary-aware keyword/phrase matching on ticket text plus linked findings; highest category keyword count, configuration-order ties, explicit fallback; first matching priority rule wins
behavior.adaptive: Category and experience select steps; recursively includes prerequisites even outside their audience/category; preferred supported presentation mode or explained first-mode fallback
behavior.extraction: Case-insensitive multiline trusted regex configuration; first nonempty named capture in assigned document order; exact spans; null missing values; lists all missing and required missing fields; complete refers only to required fields
behavior.determinism: No randomness, current-time dependencies, network requests, provider calls or LLM steps
behavior.limits: 100 documents, tickets, steps or extraction fields; 20000 characters per text; 500 characters per regex; 100-character identifiers

included: One integrated deterministic CLI and shared validation layer
Standard-library unittest and subprocess CLI coverage
excluded: Live research, external providers, LLM calls and integrations
Enterprise authentication, persistence, queues and deployment
Semantic inference beyond deterministic lexical rules
OCR, binary documents and semantic field type conversion
Sandboxed untrusted regex execution or regex timeout guarantees

cli.stdout: One valid JSON object with status=ok and all four validated stages
